idea-plugin.name: Claude Cream for IDEA
idea-plugin.description: An unofficial warm editorial IntelliJ Platform theme adapted from the Claude Cream palette. Includes coordinated Light and Dark UI themes, editor color schemes, terminal colors, VCS states, diagnostics, search highlights, and Diff colors.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Initial Claude Cream Light and Dark themes.
  • Palette synchronized with claude-cream tokens 1.0.0.
  • Compatible with IntelliJ Platform 2024.3 and newer.
